sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:68

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:68:1
items.html: A bending fire that caused damage — these are the discernments of these lights of the female, which are the fire of Gevura, and it is a bending fire: For the Hassadim are called luminaries of light, which are the discernment of the five lights from the first day of the Creation. And the Gevurot are called luminaries of fire, being a fire blazing from below upward, which is the secret of reflected light. And since they come and are drawn from the new back of ZA, which is the AHP of Bina, they therefore receive there a great sweetening, and her Gevurot are reckoned as bending. This will be further explained in its place.
